thread:
lina (Billing): Heads up: nightly batch invoice_job_2026-03-23-03 created a small set (~7) of invoices where discounts applied in summary but missing from line-items (Customers: BetaTek, Aurora Labs). Example: invoice 20260323-BETA-03 shows total 450.00 with a summary discount 50.00 but no 'Promo discount' line.

matt (Billing Eng): I can repro that when promo_rules lookup returns empty for legacy promo IDs. suspect promo service cache eviction during job.

kevin (SRE): noticed a brief spike in promo-cache misses at 00:12:40Z due to redis failover. Redis master switched and cache warm-up took ~30s.

matt (Billing Eng): renderer currently does: if discount_id and promo_rules[discount_id].amount: add line. If promo_rules missing, we drop the line. Need fallback to create "Discount (placeholder)" when summary shows discount_total > 0.

rachel (Support): two customers already emailed support asking why line isn't visible. We should avoid confusing wording. Aim to include reason like '(discount applied at account level)'.

ella (Accounting): those invoices fail our discount GL reconciliation jobs. We need CSV for affected invoices so we can post entries correctly.

lina (Billing): action plan: 1) change renderer to include fallback discount line when discount_total > 0; 2) add metric for missing promo_rules; 3) re-render affected invoices and publish a corrected PDF; 4) ensure dedupe if re-render creates new artifacts.

matt (Billing Eng): quick patch to rendering logic and redis client backoff. patch will attempt promo_service.get(discount_id) with retry=3. adding code: 

```
promo = promo_service.get(discount_id)
if not promo and discount_total > 0:
    lines.append({ 'desc': 'Promo discount (account-level)', 'amount': -discount_total })
```

kevin (SRE): I'll monitor redis failover metrics and bump up the failover wait. Also will run a one-off warmup of promo cache prior to the next billing window.

rachel (Support): I'll draft a short customer message explaining corrected PDFs will be issued and include FAQ blurb about account-level promos.

finance-bot: Alert: invoice_job_20260323-03: 7 missing-discount-line renders, redis failover at 00:12:40Z correlated.

ella (Accounting): include CSV columns: invoice_id, customer_id, discount_total, missing_discount_flag, original_pdf_url. We'll run GL adjustments before sending refunds, if any.

lina (Billing): scheduling re-render window for 2026-03-23 02:00-02:15 UTC. matt, please post when hotfix is deployed to prod.

matt (Billing Eng): will ship hotfix after unit tests (ETA 30m).
